definitions.meaning: the god Tiw, a Teutonic deity to whom amongst the Latin gods Mars most nearly corresponded

quotations.old_english: Ðone Syxtum nédde Decius se cásere Tíges (Martis) deófolgylde

quotations.citations: R. Ben. 38, 6; R. Ben. Interl. 49, 14: Wulfst. 180, 25

definitions.supplemental: Ti is given as the name of the symbol RUNE in some alphabets, see Kemble on Anglo-Saxon Runes in Archæologia, vol. 28, pp. 338, 339. The word is probably to be recognized in the form tyz, which is given as the name of the Gothic T in the Vienna MS. containing a Gothic alphabet, and from it a Gothic Tius may be inferred. O. H. Ger. Ziu(-o) the name of a god (preserved in M. H. Ger. Zies-tag), the name of a letter: Icel. Týr the name of a god (kept in Týs-dagr), name of a rune. See Grmm. D. M. c. ix.
definitions.meaning: one form of the name of the Runic T
